## Algorithm

* [Coupling orders: interaction splitting and expansion_order caps](coupling-orders.md) - One interaction per coupling-order tuple, as MadGraph's add_interaction; an unconstrained order is capped only when 0 < expansion_order < 99; the WEIGHTED hierarchy keeps auxiliary fields out.
* [Restrict-card semantics](restriction-semantics.md) - Restriction drops zero couplings, then empty vertices, then unreferenced Lorentz structures; a card's non-zero values become defaults and its zeros lock, as in MadGraph's generated param_card.

## Caveat

* [Writing a UFO MadGraph reads the way we do](ufo-authoring-for-madgraph.md) - A non-self-conjugate vertex needs its h.c. listed; without a T(a,i,j) vertex MadGraph guesses 3/3̄ labels (fatal with an epsilon); a model must declare QCD.

## Design

* [Every param-card construct is classified: consumed, benign or refused](param-card-classification.md) - PARAM_CARD (ufo/card_classes.rs) lists each construct MadGraph's SLHA reader accepts in a run's param card with its class and an example the test binds; decay tables, negative masses, scan values and extra DECAY fields are refused, XSECTION is skipped as MadGraph skips it.
* [Every restrict-card construct is classified: consumed, benign or refused](restrict-card-classification.md) - RESTRICT_CARD (ufo/card_classes.rs) lists each construct MadGraph's restriction reads, with its class and an edit of the SM's restrict_default the test restricts; a missing parameter, MadGraph's unfixed one and zero, a non-finite value and a param_<x>.dat beside the card are refused.
* [UFO parsing: Python AST for files, PEG for expression strings](ufo-parsing.md) - UFO files are parsed with rustpython-parser into our own UFOModel; PEG grammars read only expression strings; feyngraph gets topology only; propagators.py is parsed and attached per particle.

## Design Decision

* [Model identity: SHA-256 over the serialized restricted model](model-identity-digest.md) - The integrate artifact banks the import label and a SHA-256 of the restricted ParsedModel's bincode bytes, so generate refuses a model whose files changed after integrate.

## Overview

* [The vendored SMEFTsim topU3l MwScheme UFO](smeftsim-topu3l.md) - What SMEFTsim_topU3l_MwScheme_UFO contains and what its restrict cards turn on; vendored byte-for-byte (v3.0.2, db7d4a80) with LICENSE, SHA256SUMS and provenance, not a 101 MB submodule.

## Physics Convention

* [UFO spin codes, ALOHA value families and Lorentz structures by spin](ufo-aloha-type-matrix.md) - UFO spin codes (2s+1, −1 for ghosts), ALOHA value families by spin, operator tokens per SM vertex class, and ProjM/ProjP naming by the sign in (1±γ5)/2.
* [UFO expression, Lorentz and colour string grammars](ufo-string-grammars.md) - Python-precedence expression grammar; the Lorentz-structure grammar (Gamma, Sigma, ProjM/P, Epsilon, P, X**n expansion); colour atoms, T index order and rep-dependent Identity resolution.
